planets.name: HIP 67522 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HIP 67522 with a 6.96-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: HIP 67522 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HIP 67522. Its orbit and size follow Barber et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname BARBER_ET_AL__2024): disc_year 2020, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 2; pl_orbper 6.9594731, pl_radj 0.891, pl_bmassj 0.225

quotes.title: HIP 67522 b
quotes.card: HIP 67522 b is a hot Neptune or sub-Saturn exoplanet orbiting the G-type star HIP 67522, approximately 415 light-years from Earth in the constellation Centaurus.
quotes.introduction: It was discovered using the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS).
